text:
Type: tall glossy white plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant on a floor, a shelf or a windowsill; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: glazed ceramic with a smooth high-gloss finish
Colors: creamy white
Shape: tall tapered cone that widens toward the open rim, slim recessed foot, smooth seamless sides, slender and elegant
Feel: clean, bright, elegant, calm
Goes with: green leafy plants, light wood, white or pastel walls, brass accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: PAPAJA
product.description: The shape and height of the pot make it suitable for orchids.
